title: LLM-GUIDED ADAPTIVE STEP-SIZE ZEROING NEURAL NETWORK FOR ROBOTIC MANIPULATOR TRAJECTORY TRACKING
model_class: DTZNN (forward-Euler discrete ZNN) with LLM-selected variable step size
problem_class: robot manipulator trajectory tracking (inverse kinematics, Franka Panda in CoppeliaSim)
ev_R3: "For real-time implementation, the continuous dynamics are discretized using a forward-Euler scheme" (Sec. 2.2)
ev_R4: "The manipulator begins tracking the infinity-like path with an initial step-size tau = 0.05 s" (Sec. 3.1); baselines tau = 0.01 s and 0.10 s (Sec. 3.2)
ev_R6: "comparing it with two fixed-step ZNN baselines. All three methods operate on the same infinity-like path and use identical ZNN parameters except for the step-size" (Sec. 3.2)
step_value: tau=0.05 s (initial, then LLM-adjusted within a clipped 'safe range'); fixed baselines tau=0.01 s and 0.10 s
solver_detail: explicit forward-Euler DTZNN with time-varying step chosen by an LLM; MATLAB controller + CoppeliaSim via Remote API
notes: Full text from the journal PDF galley (upsjournals.com/wjer/article/download/1813/1621). One tracking task (infinity-like path) used in Exps 1-2; Exp 3 tests LLM instruction interpretation (300 phrases), not a ZNN problem. R2=7 assumes the standard 7-DOF Franka Panda (joint count not stated). Baseline = fixed-step Euler ZNN at two step sizes (counted as one model). The step-size safe range (Eq. 10) is a clipping rule without derivation (R5=no). LLM model/version not identified in the text; formulas are images in the PDF. Real-robot experiments listed as future work.

title: A Direct-Discrete Robust Neurodynamics Algorithm for Precise Control of Multi-Finger Robotic Hand
model_class: direct-discrete noise-tolerant ZNN (DDRN, three-step Taylor-type formula with error-sum term)
problem_class: multi-finger robotic hand trajectory tracking (constrained time-varying QP)
ev_R3: "the derivative term x_k-dot in (17) is discretized by the three-step general Taylor-type discretization formula [34]" (Sec. 2.2)
ev_R4: "The sampling time is set as tau = 0.02, K_max = 5/tau" (Sec. 4)
ev_R6: "To enable a comprehensive comparison of algorithm performance, this study additionally includes the DFTCN algorithm [16]" (Sec. 4); parameters listed jointly (gamma1=0.82, gamma2=0.012, lambda1=5, ...), no matching argument
ev_R11: no code/data statement found ('The original contributions presented in this study are included in the article')
solver_detail: direct discrete multistep (three-step Taylor-type) iteration, MATLAB R2025b
notes: One tracking task for a 15-DoF five-finger hand under zero, constant (0.01), linear (0.01(k tau+1)) and bounded random noise. R5=yes: Theorems 1-4 derive the error recursion with O(tau^3) truncation, a spectral-radius condition on (gamma1, gamma2) and steady-state residual orders O(tau^3)/O(tau^2)/O(tau) for zero/linear/random noise. Baseline: DFTCN [16] with its own parameterization; gains not matched or discussed.
